definitions.gloss: film studio; soundstage; movie studio lot
definitions.explanation: A facility where films, television shows, or other video productions are shot, including indoor stages and outdoor lots.

examples.japanese: {撮影所|さつえいじょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{撮影所|さつえいじょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧いくつ⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are several film studios in Kyoto as well.

examples.japanese: ⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧{撮影所|さつえいじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The actors arrive at the studio early every morning to prepare.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{撮影|さつえい}→撮影：04175_satsuei⟧ (filming/photography) and {所|じょ} (place). Refers to the physical facility where productions are filmed, including sound stages, back lots, and support buildings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {撮影所|さつえいじょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to tour a film studio
- {撮影所|さつえいじょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{撮影|さつえい}する→撮影する：21990_satsueisuru⟧: to film at a studio
- ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧{撮影所|さつえいじょ}: movie studio

CULTURAL NOTE:
Famous Japanese film studios include {東映|とうえい}{太秦|うずまさ}{撮影所|さつえいじょ} (Toei Uzumasa Studio) in Kyoto and {東宝|とうほう}⟦スタジオ→スタジオ：11583_sutajio⟧ in Tokyo. The Kyoto studios are known for period dramas (⟦{時代劇|じだいげき}→時代劇：12968_jidaigeki⟧) and some are open to tourists.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦スタジオ→スタジオ：11583_sutajio⟧: studio (loanword) — used for both film/TV studios and recording studios; more casual
- ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧{会社|がいしゃ}: film company — the business entity rather than the physical facility
- ⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧: set — the specific constructed environment within a studio
